title: Arithmetic intersections on non-split Cartan modular curves
summary: Let $p$ be a prime number, and let $Δ_1,Δ_2 < 0$ be two coprime fundamental discriminants. When $p$ splits in $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{Δ_1})$ and $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{Δ_2})$ the height pairings of the corresponding CM divisors on $X_{\mathrm{spl}}^+(p)$ were determined by Gross--Kohnen--Zagier [GKZ87]. When $p$ is inert, we determine the arithmetic intersection numbers of the corresponding divisors on $X_{\mathrm{ns}}^+(p)$ at all finite primes.
